label: Fee Demand Scam
text: Dear Candidate, You are shortlisted for Work-from-Home Data Assistant at Apex Global Solutions. Monthly stipend: Rs. 45,000. Please deposit Rs. 1,500 registration charge (refundable) via UPI to hr-apex@upi for onboarding kit allocation. Connect immediately on Telegram: @ApexHR_Instant to receive your appointment letter.

payload.transcript: Dear Candidate, You are shortlisted for Work-from-Home Data Assistant at Apex Global Solutions. Monthly stipend: Rs. 45,000. Please deposit Rs. 1,500 registration charge (refundable) via UPI to hr-apex@upi for onboarding kit allocation. Connect immediately on Telegram: @ApexHR_Instant to receive your appointment letter.

payload.summary: High risk: We detected 2 critical warning indicator(s) in this offer (e.g., registration charge, immediately).

red_flags.why_it_matters: Legitimate employers never demand registration, training, security deposit, or kit fees from candidates.
Artificial urgency is used by fraudsters to rush candidates into acting without verifying details.

next_steps: Do not pay any registration, training, kit, or security deposit fees.
Do not share OTPs, passwords, or personal ID documents (Aadhaar, PAN).
Verify the company on its official website and reach out only through officially listed contacts.
Report fraudulent job offers at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930 (National Cyber Crime Helpline).
Real employers do not charge candidates to hire them.
